role: Administrator, National Highway Traffic Safety Administration
stance_basis: signs the Final EIS as Administrator, presenting the agency's analysis without personal advocacy for or against the standard
summary: John W. Snow, as Administrator of NHTSA, signed the Final Environmental Impact Statement for the Average Fuel Economy Standard for Nonpassenger Automobiles, Model Year 1979, dated 3/3/77. His role in the document is as the issuing authority who promulgated the standard and oversaw the EIS process; the document presents the agency's analysis of a range of fuel economy standards (16.4–18.7 mpg, with a separate 14.9–17.4 mpg class for four-wheel drive recreational vehicles) and their environmental impacts. No personal complaints or advocacy positions are attributed to him beyond his administrative role in signing and issuing the document.
complaint_summary: John W. Snow is identified as the Administrator of NHTSA who signed the Final Environmental Impact Statement on 3/3/77, serving as the issuing authority for the document rather than expressing a personal complaint or position.
